<Task version="1.2" xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/windows/2004/02/mit/task">
  <RegistrationInfo>
    <Author>Tunero</Author>
    <Description>Applies your Tunero changes again that Windows has reset, two minutes after you sign in. Turn it off in Tunero's Settings or undo it on the Changes page.</Description>
    <URI>\Tunero\Apply changes again S-1-5-21-1-2-3-1001</URI>
  </RegistrationInfo>
  <Triggers>
    <LogonTrigger>
      <Enabled>true</Enabled>
      <UserId>S-1-5-21-1-2-3-1001</UserId>
      <Delay>PT2M</Delay>
    </LogonTrigger>
  </Triggers>
  <Principals>
    <Principal id="Author">
      <UserId>S-1-5-21-1-2-3-1001</UserId>
      <LogonType>InteractiveToken</LogonType>
      <RunLevel>HighestAvailable</RunLevel>
    </Principal>
  </Principals>
  <Settings>
    <MultipleInstancesPolicy>IgnoreNew</MultipleInstancesPolicy>
    <DisallowStartIfOnBatteries>false</DisallowStartIfOnBatteries>
    <StopIfGoingOnBatteries>false</StopIfGoingOnBatteries>
    <AllowHardTerminate>true</AllowHardTerminate>
    <StartWhenAvailable>false</StartWhenAvailable>
    <AllowStartOnDemand>true</AllowStartOnDemand>
    <Enabled>true</Enabled>
    <ExecutionTimeLimit>PT30M</ExecutionTimeLimit>
    <Priority>7</Priority>
  </Settings>
  <Actions Context="Author">
    <Exec>
      <Command>C:\Program Files\Tunero\Tunero.exe</Command>
      <Arguments>--reapply</Arguments>
    </Exec>
  </Actions>
</Task>","TargetKey":"owntask:user:\tunero\apply changes again s-1-5-21-1-2-3-1001","IsBootCritical":false,"TakesEffectAfterRestart":false,"EarlyRead":"none"}
